navigation_bar.desktop: Brand logo on left, 5 visible nav links (Home, Courses, Faculty, Admissions, Demo Class, Contact) + Portal Login trigger CTA button
navigation_bar.mobile: Accessible Sheet/Drawer menu with mobile toggle icon
navigation_bar.critical_rule: Header must never be 100% transparent. Always use semi-opaque backdrop blur with z-50.

tables_and_data.style: Clean cardless table container with inner scroll. Sticky table headers with subtle background (`bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900`).
tables_and_data.actions: Inline actions dropdown or primary action badges.
tables_and_data.search_and_filters: SearchBar on left + Filter select dropdowns + Status badges.

forms_and_modals.inputs: Shadcn UI Input, Select, Checkbox, Calendar for date selection. Clear active focus rings in Academic Teal (`ring-teal-500`).
forms_and_modals.dialogs: Clean centered modal overlay with clear close button and data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure EduPrime Academy has a cohesive identity across the public marketing website, admin dashboard, student portal, and faculty portal.
Do NOT use pure #000000 black or bright distracting full-screen gradients. Stick to Deep Navy (#0F172A), Slate, Pure White, and Academic Teal accents.
Every interactive button, input, link, tab, modal trigger, and table row MUST include a clear `data-testid` attribute.
Use standard Lucide icons (`lucide-react`) for UI actions and metric indicators.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for forms (Admission Enquiry, Demo Booking, Fee Receipts, Attendance Marking).
Ensure the mobile navigation menu works smoothly using Shadcn Sheet or mobile dropdowns.
